text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ace, Ace! Pull yourself together!
Waaaahhhhh~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed into the classroom where the scream came from,
only to find Katsuragi Ace lying motionless
on the floor—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't know...!
When I walked into the classroom, Ace-san was collapsed on the floor...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-Wh-Wh-What should we do~...?!
Ace isn't answering meee~!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
S-She isn't moving at all...
Wait, is she not even breathing...?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now—we have an incident on our hands!
You two, find the culprit!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The hint must be in this classroom.
The culprit who attacked Ace-san left evidence at the scene—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "A-A-Anyway! I'm gonna go call the teacher!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Um, um... Then Turbo will go get Tazuna-san!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh, wait a second?!
This is—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Did they leave already?!
You did explain it properly to them, right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Yes. I told them it was a game about finding the culprit from clues scattered around this room, but..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, Ace-san and the rest of us
were supposed to play a mystery game together."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I was the facilitator. Turbo-san and Tannhauser-san were the detectives. And Ace-san was planned to play the role of both the victim and the culprit.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
We'll do explanations later, Ikuno!
Right now, we gotta chase after those guys.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense.
Let's split up, then.
I'll look for Tannhauser-san!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take Turbo!
If we don't stop her fast, it's gonna get outta hand!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah............ Huh?
Where does Tazuna-san usually hang around...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Found you!! Stoooop, Turbooo!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaa!? It's a zombiiiiiiie--!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey! You're not getting away!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Stooop!! Don't bite meee!
I don't wanna become a zombiiie~~!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Who are you calling a zombie?!
I'm perfectly alive, thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Phew, looks like things worked out on your end too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was a close call, though.
And—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo, Ms. Tannhauser.
Didn't I tell you we'd be doing a mystery game
in this classroom today?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
T-That might be true, but... Ace-san's
collapsed and not moving at all...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I panicked thinking maybe you weren't acting~.
I'm so sorry~!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oops, maybe my playing dead was a little too realistic.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was a truly gripping performance.
I had heard before that you were skilled at it,
but I never imagined it would be to that extent.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh, lived up to the hype, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that's what caused the misunderstanding, though.
I should've taken a more casual approach."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's just not in my nature to slack off.
No matter what it is, I end up putting my all into it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was super realistic and amazing!
Turbo wants to try it too!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Playing the victim sounds fun too!
Is there a secret to acting it well?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you guys want to try too?
Let's see here...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer-san?
What's the trick to playing dead convincingly?
choice_data_list: Maybe try putting strength into your whole body?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you really get it! That's exactly right.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
To stay completely motionless,
you have to tense every single muscle in your body, you know.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just don't let anyone catch on.
Stay relaxed while applying power... that's the trick.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Playing dead... It seems this tests
my acting skills far more than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: There are plenty of details, but in the end, that's what it comes down to!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: As long as you've got guts, you can manage anything! Giving it a shot is what counts!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's got guts!
I'll do my best at playing dead!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I can't let myself lose either!
Haha!
